seo.title: Numo Ierapetra Crete: Adults-Only Beach Honeymoon (2026)
seo.description: Adults-only south-coast Crete resort, Libyan Sea views. Score 89/100, from €350/night. Best room, 7-night plan, real cost, honest 2026 verdict, email.

content.verdict: Numo Ierapetra is the south coast's purpose-built adults-only honeymoon resort — a 200-key contemporary property on a 600m sand beach facing the Libyan Sea, opened in 2022 as Crete's answer to the Greek-island adults-only category (Mykonos, Santorini) but at a south-coast price level that runs 30–40% below Elounda. The architectural and culinary ambition is genuinely high — five restaurants, swim-up bar geometry, a 1,500sqm spa, and standalone Beachfront Suites with private pools on the sand. The reason couples choose Numo over Elounda is the combination of strict adults-only policy (16+), south-coast Libyan Sea geography (warmer water than the north coast, calmer in summer because the Meltemi blows from the north), and the lower price point. The trade-off is location: Ierapetra is a 90-minute drive from Heraklion airport, the town itself is not picturesque, and the coastal stretch lacks Elounda's resort-cluster prestige.
content.best_room: Beachfront Suite with Private Pool — the front-row standalone suites directly on the sand with a 6m private heated pool, private outdoor shower, and direct beach access. For honeymooners with a higher budget, the Numo Royal Suite (top floor of the main wing, 90sqm, infinity-edge pool with sea view) is the resort's signature room. Avoid the Garden View entries — they are the value tier and lose the sea-side proximity that defines the property.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival on the Libyan Sea
itinerary_7_nights.description: Fly into Heraklion (HER) — 90 minutes by private transfer south across the island. Welcome drink on the Beachfront Suite terrace. Sunset cocktails at the Cinque Pool Bar, dinner at Lumi — the signature Mediterranean dining room facing the sea.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach Day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Late breakfast at Pelagia, morning on the 600m sand beach with private sunbeds, lunch at Riva on the beach, afternoon at the swim-up adults pool. Evening at Nima — the resort's chic sushi-and-grill dining room.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Chrissi Island Day Trip
itinerary_7_nights.description: Day boat 12km south from Ierapetra port to the uninhabited Chrissi (Donkey Island) — Caribbean-grade turquoise water, white sand, cedar forest, snorkelling. Return for sunset swim and dinner at Erato (Cretan tasting menu).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spinalonga & East Crete Drive
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 1 hour north-east to Plaka for the boat to Spinalonga. Return via Elounda and the scenic Lasithi Plateau windmill road. Lunch at Migomis in Agios Nikolaos with Mirabello Bay views. Return for evening at the spa.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa & Rest
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full rest day — 90-minute couple's massage at the Numo spa, afternoon hammam, lounging in the suite pool. Dinner on the suite terrace with in-suite chef option.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Vai Palm Beach
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 1.5 hours east to Vai — Europe's largest natural palm grove fronting a turquoise bay. Stop at the monastery of Toplou on the way. Lunch at a south-coast taverna at Xerokampos. Return for evening at Lumi.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast at Pelagia, last swim in the suite pool, 90-minute transfer back to HER. Numo offers paid late-checkout to 14:00.

caveats: Ierapetra is a 90-minute drive from Heraklion airport and 75 minutes from Elounda — Numo is not a base for combining with the Elounda cluster as a single week.
Ierapetra town is a working agricultural town, not a postcard village — the resort itself is the destination, and the surrounding area is not the Cretan picture-postcard.
Rates are not all-inclusive; the five restaurants run €70–€140 per couple per dinner. Budget realistically for full board across seven nights.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Yes — Numo is purpose-built for adults-only honeymoons. The combination of strict 16+ policy, Libyan Sea warmth, Beachfront Suites with private pools, and the price differential below Elounda makes this the strongest value adults-only resort in Crete.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May through October. The Libyan Sea is warmer than the north coast (peak 27°C in August versus 25°C north) and protected from the summer Meltemi wind. June and September are ideal honeymoon months.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Beachfront Suites with Private Pool book 4–5 months ahead for July–September. The Numo Royal Suite sells out 6–9 months ahead for peak summer. Mention honeymoon — the resort offers an excellent honeymoon package with welcome amenities, one complimentary dinner, and a spa credit.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: Yes, strictly 16+. No children at all on property. The adults-only policy is the resort's defining feature and the reason couples choose Numo over the family-friendly Elounda cluster.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Beachfront Suite with Private Pool — front-row standalone suite on the sand with private pool, outdoor shower, and beach access. The Numo Royal Suite is the higher-budget upgrade.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Heraklion International (HER) is 90 minutes by private transfer (€120–€150 each way). The resort arranges all transfers. Sitia (JSH) regional airport is 75 minutes east but has very limited international service.
